note: NECO Government Paper III round 1: fresh SSCE-standard items on stable historical and definitional facts — Nigerian constitutions 1922-1999, colonial administration, nationalism, organs of government, parties, pressure groups, elections, federalism, local government, civil service, public corporations, military era, foreign policy and international organisations. Near-duplicate scanned against the JAMB and WAEC banks.
